{{Quote|Come on, Luunti, we don't have time to waste, here.|Targen hurries Luunti as she installs the devices|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Luunti''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] as part of a [[Targen's gang|gang]] lead by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Targen]]. In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Luunti and her fellow gang members were hired to install [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]] in the room of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] known as [[Red Blade]], who was staying in the [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]. The Blade, who was actually an [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Imperial Agent|agent]] called [[Cipher Nine]], returned to her room while the gang were installing the devices and killed them.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Someone wanted to know what you were up to&mdash;but I guess that plan's off, now.|Targen explains why he and Luunti are in the agent's room|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Luunti worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], she was a part of a [[Targen's gang|gang]] of freelance criminals lead by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Targen]], who were hired to install [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]] in one of the guest rooms in the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]s [[Nem'ro's Palace|Palace]]. The room was being used at the time by a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] known as the [[Red Blade]] who had recently completed a number of tasks for Nem'ro's lieutenant [[Karrels Javis]], although unknown to anyone in the palace the individual was actually an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Agent]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] known as [[Cipher Nine]]. Luunti accompanied Targen and two other gang members to the room while the Blade was out and the Rodian began installing the devices, including one under the mercenary's bed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{GameDSmechanics}}
Targen hurried Luunti as she worked, but the group were not quick enough and the undercover agent arrived before they were finished. Targen turned to greet the Red Blade, after which the agent attacked and killed all four gang members in the room, including Luunti.<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'm going as fast as I&mdash;|Luunti is interrupted by the Imperial Agent's arrival|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
Luunti had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and purple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. As a Rodian, she lacked [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. She was willing to follow Targen's lead in attacking the Red Blade, a mercenary with a dangerous reputation.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Equipment==
Luunti wore brown [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] while installing the listening devices in the Red Blade's room.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Luunti was created for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. She appeared in the quest "Economies of Scale" which is part of the Imperial Agent class's story on the planet Hutta. Players have the option to immediately attack the gang upon entering the room for dark side points, trying to make a deal with them for light side points or asking who hired them for no alignment points. This article assumes that players chose the dark side option as the Agent is an Imperial character, although attempting to talk with the gang still results in their deaths as they attack the player.
